title: Not fabulous at all
body:
Seemed like very interesting app when I clicked on the add only to find later that the app is full of ads and it’s just a clickbait starting from the add on instagram followed by the app.
Furthermore, I have paid subscription for trial period, only to find out that money is not reimbursable after the cancellation only after 4 days.
After the cancellation, I received text from my bank account saying that they tried to charge me another subscription…shame on you
author: Petronificus
